Exp18.purpose: Scaled instruction SFT and short scientific explanation evaluation
Exp18.hypothesis: Evaluating whether the 3.44M ChakrMicro model can generate coherent, factually grounded scientific explanations on out-of-distribution prompts
Exp18.outcome: 100% human rejection rate (20/20 rejections). Verified that 3.44M parameter baseline cannot generalize to ungrounded scientific reasoning without retrieval grounding.

Exp19.purpose: Debiased SFT curriculum and template distribution balancing
Exp19.hypothesis: Reducing prefix bias and balancing slot frequencies will improve context copying fidelity without catastrophic forgetting
Exp19.outcome: Identified attractor collapse loops during greedy generation; led to n-gram blocking and cognitive router design.

Exp20.purpose: Single-task contextual binding under bounded context length
Exp20.hypothesis: Restricting SFT objective to single-slot key-value extraction isolates attention copy mechanisms
Exp20.outcome: Verified in-distribution copy saturation (98%+ on known tokens), but failure to generalize to arbitrary unseen vocabularies.

Exp21.purpose: Synthetic recombined copy benchmark and evaluation suite
Exp21.hypothesis: Evaluating copy transfer across recombined n-gram slots
Exp21.outcome: Committed to repository in commit aa47d7c.

Exp22_Exp23.purpose: Attention copy loss gradient diagnostic and single-token copy audit
Exp22_Exp23.hypothesis: Testing whether auxiliary copy loss gradients destabilize RoPE attention representations in early layers
Exp22_Exp23.outcome: Committed to repository in commit aa47d7c.

Exp24_Exp25.purpose: Copying vs routing diagnostic and disjoint vocabulary generalization
Exp24_Exp25.hypothesis: Comparing pure neural pointer copy against cognitive routing when presented with out-of-vocabulary entities
Exp24_Exp25.outcome: Exp24 committed in feb0939. Exp25 shows severe accuracy drop on disjoint vocab (12.5% vs 95% on in-distribution). Proves copy priors do not generalize zero-shot.

Exp26.purpose: 15M parameter scaling hypothesis and diagnostic benchmark
Exp26.hypothesis: Designing a 15M parameter architecture (width 288, 8 layers, 8 heads) to increase logit entropy and mitigate attractor collapse
Exp26.outcome: Architecture configuration committed in 255537a and b771388. Mission report and evaluation logs remain local.

Exp27.purpose: Forensic pointer research, leakage audit, and gradient diagnostics
Exp27.hypothesis: Independent audit of pointer attention heads to determine whether reported copy gains were authentic or artifacts of template leakage
Exp27.outcome: Confirmed that pointer heads overfit to synthetic template delimiters and fail when distractor positions shift. Identified template leakage as a major risk factor.

Exp28.purpose: Fair baseline vs pointer comparative study (Arm A vs Arm B)
Exp28.hypothesis: Controlled comparison between canonical LM (Arm A) and pointer-augmented LM (Arm B) on identical, strictly isolated data splits
Exp28.outcome: Decisive proof that Arm B (pointer) does NOT provide statistically significant advantage over Arm A when template positions are randomized. Pointer mechanism quarantined from v0.8.0 release.

Exp29.purpose: Independent replication and audit of Exp28 findings
Exp29.hypothesis: Re-evaluating Exp28 metrics using frozen independent evaluation harnesses to ensure reproducibility and absence of evaluator bias
Exp29.outcome: Replicated Exp28 findings exactly. Verified robustness across distractor permutations.

Exp30.purpose: Human review closure, release gate matrix, and v0.8.0 release readiness
Exp30.hypothesis: Finalizing all 12 release gates, reviewing human explanation scores, and confirming canonical checkpoint integrity
Exp30.outcome: Verified all release gates. Authorized v0.8.0 release candidate.
